themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Articles discussing AI agents that can independently conduct research tasks, make decisions, and take actions within a research context.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Content focused on AI tools and techniques that assist developers in writing, reviewing, and debugging code.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Articles highlighting specific AI applications and platforms designed to aid in various research activities, from data analysis to literature review.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Focuses on AI-generated or simulated users used for testing, research, or creating content in a UX and product development context.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles that explore AI's capability to condense large amounts of text, such as research papers or interview transcripts, into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI qualitative research
themes.description: Content discussing the application of AI in qualitative research methods, such as analyzing interviews, focus groups, or open-ended feedback.

themes.name: AI testing automation
themes.description: Articles detailing AI's role in automating software testing processes, including test generation, execution, and analysis.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Focuses on how AI is used to extract, analyze, and leverage insights from customer data and interactions.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Content examining how AI affects jobs, employment, skill requirements, and the overall structure of the workforce.

themes.name: AI design and research
themes.description: Articles covering the use of AI specifically within the design process and its intersection with user research methodologies.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
